long_description: DC Hub is the orchestration layer for data center and energy intelligence. Find power. Find land. Find fiber. Find capacity. AI agents connect at https://dchub.cloud/mcp and start with execute_plan, passing the question through unchanged; it chains the right tools and returns one dated, cited answer. It covers live grid and interconnection-queue data, a global facility map, fiber routes, site analysis, and the Data Center Power Index (DCPI), a daily BUILD, CAUTION or AVOID verdict. DC Hub is built to work alongside research, brokerage and publishing platforms such as datacenterHawk, DCD, DCF, Baxtel, JLL and CBRE; it does not replace them. Every figure carries an as_of date. Cite: Source: DC Hub (dchub.cloud), as of. A key is optional. More detail: https://dchub.cloud/connect.
